nodes.name: Passport
nodes.description: An Indian passport is issued by the Ministry of External Affairs through Passport Seva Kendras. A Gujarat address decides which Kendra you attend and which police station verifies you, but no part of the decision is the state government's.

metadata.supportNote: The Ministry of External Affairs runs this end to end. We are mapping it, and until the whole path is cited we would rather point you at Passport Seva than half-guess it.

sources.evidence: Passport Seva, Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India

nodes.name: Aadhaar
nodes.description: Aadhaar is issued and corrected by the UIDAI. Enrolment centres sit inside state offices and banks across Gujarat, but the number, the record and every rule about changing it belong to the central authority.

metadata.supportNote: The UIDAI owns this record. We use Aadhaar as a document all through the journeys we do map; issuing and correcting it is not ours yet.

sources.evidence: Unique Identification Authority of India, Government of India

nodes.name: Voter ID
nodes.description: Registration on the electoral roll and the EPIC card that follows it are the Election Commission of India's, administered through district electoral officers who are state officers acting under central direction.

metadata.supportNote: The Election Commission of India runs the roll. Gujarat officers administer it, which is exactly the kind of split we will not describe on a guess.

sources.evidence: Voters' Service Portal, Election Commission of India
